headline: Israeli military strikes Hezbollah rockets and launchers in Lebanon Beqaa Valley
label: BREAKING
caption:
The Israeli military launched heavy strikes targeting Hezbollah rockets and launchers in Lebanon. 🚀

According to the Times of Israel and The Jerusalem Post, the operations hit military infrastructure including a Radwan Force training camp in the Beqaa Valley.

Authorities stated that the strikes were aimed at dismantling active weapon caches and rocket launchers belonging to the group.

Regional tensions remain critically high as military exchanges continue across the border.
